description: 35 active skills + 3 deprecated redirects (verify, checkpoint, browser-auth) - adds doppler (hub/spoke secrets) and memory-backup (private git repo for auto-memory)

core.description: prd.json schema and task system - auto-loaded when prd.json exists

standards.description: Type safety, design tokens, UI states, React/Next.js patterns from production.

auto.description: Autonomous task execution with testing and security. Works through all tasks without stopping.

iterate.description: Convergence loop — brainstorm, fix, re-scan until the codebase is clean. Combines brainstorm→apply→auto in one command.

brainstorm.description: Feature ideation, dead code cleanup, and product thinking. Proposes new features and architecture improvements — not bugs or violations (use audit for those).

status.description: Shows sprint progress and task status. Use 'progress' (not 'status' - that's a built-in).

sprint.description: Creates or advances sprints in prd.json. Use when starting new work cycles or closing completed sprints.

review.description: Code quality check with adaptive effort scaling. Includes security scanning.

pr-review.description: Comprehensive PR review using specialized agents. Use before creating or merging pull requests.

clean.description: Removes temporary screenshots, old backups, stale handoffs, and auto-active flags. Use when project has accumulated temp files.

test.description: Runs unit and browser tests on latest changes. Use after implementing features or fixing bugs.

ship.description: Pre-deploy checklist with review, security, and test verification. Use when ready to deploy.

fix.description: Debugs and fixes issues systematically. Use when something is broken, throwing errors, or behaving unexpectedly.

setup-project.description: Scaffolds new projects or onboards existing ones. Detects stack, creates monorepo/single-app, configures strict tooling. Use for greenfield or first-time setup.

stripe.description: Stripe integration patterns - API keys, webhooks, checkout, subscriptions. Loads when working with payments.

seo.description: SEO audit and structured data patterns - meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD schema, Core Web Vitals. Use for marketing sites and e-commerce.

supabase.description: Supabase CLI, Postgres performance, and schema patterns. Use for database operations, queries, RLS, and migrations.

audit.description: Parallel quality audit with 7 specialized agents (Opus). Finds bugs, violations, and quality issues. Use audit for fixes, brainstorm for features.

browser-auth.description: Deprecated. Merged into agent-browser skill. Use agent-browser for browser testing and auth token injection.

checkpoint.description: Deprecated. Use /compact instead. Claude has built-in memory that persists across sessions.

deploy.description: Deploy workflow for Vercel, Supabase, and CI/CD pipelines. Use for deployment and CI/CD setup.

verify.description: Redirects to review deep. Use review with depth levels instead.

agent-browser.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. 5-6x more token-efficient than Playwright MCP. Use for browser testing and web automation.

archive-prd.description: Archives completed stories from prd.json to reduce token usage.

env-vars.description: Manages environment variables and credentials securely. Use when configuring secrets or .env files.

design.description: Creates distinctive UI with preserved structure. Avoids generic AI aesthetics. Use when designing or refining user interfaces.

security.description: Pre-deploy security audit with vulnerability pattern scanning. Auto-loaded with review, audit, ship.

remotion.description: Best practices for Remotion - video creation in React. Use when working with video compositions, animations, or subtitles.

monitoring.description: Observability patterns for production - logging, error tracking, analytics. Use when setting up monitoring.

update.description: Updates claude-auto-dev to latest version. Syncs repo with ~/.claude.

mem-search.description: Search persistent project memory across sessions — decisions, bugs, features, discoveries

doppler.description: Manage environment variables with Doppler — auto-install CLI, login, link projects, wrap commands with `doppler run`. Replaces scattered .env files with a hub/spoke architecture.

memory-backup.description: Backs up auto-memory files to a private GitHub repo. One-command setup, committed daily via Task Scheduler (or on-demand). Restore is a single clone.

commit.description: Standardized git commit, push, and PR creation workflow.

perf.description: Web performance audit - Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, Lighthouse patterns.

scan.description: Live site QA via agent-browser (token-efficient) and Playwright (login flows). Scans pages, catches visual/functional issues, compares with baselines. Use when testing a live site or after deploying.

a11y.description: Accessibility audit and patterns - WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for React apps.

migrate.description: Dependency updates, major version upgrades, and breaking change resolution. Use when updating packages or handling deprecations.

refactor.description: Code refactoring patterns - extract, split, restructure without changing behavior.
